text: A Direct Investment of up to $750,000 is recommended with conditions. The proposed transaction has been vetted by the Investment Committee and meets risk/reward expectations, has appropriate security, and is aligned with Toronto Atmospheric Fund's Green House Gas reduction mandate.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Adopted the confidential instructions in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 26, 2018) from the Vice President, Impact Investing. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 26, 2018) from the Vice President, Impact Investing remain confidential in its entirety, as it involve the security of property belonging to the City or one of its agencies or corporations.
